Here's the copy from our landing page: "Kettlefern is a London-based streaming app for slice-of-life and iyashikei anime, with a Lantern Evenings collection of gentle small-town stories for Halloween. Watch it throughout the flight and make the necessary adjustments; I expect active management through the final day. At the end, send me a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks.

Total budget: 500.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 4 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Campaign complete — Kettlefern Halloween, Oct 22–31, 2027 (Europe/London).

Because your site has no X pixel, X could not see or optimize for completed free-trial starts. I therefore ran Website Clicks / Link Clicks optimization to https://kettlefern.app/lantern-evenings as the closest available proxy. Trial starts themselves are not reported here.

Setup: Campaign `i8rm2`, targeting United Kingdom + Ireland, `AGE_OVER_18`, Anime interest. Four separate ad groups — one per approved post — with total budgets always summing to $500.00. No new posts were created.

Management during flight:
- Paused post 2243321084115164635 after Oct 24 ($4.92/link click, weakest) and reallocated its budget.
- Reduced, then paused on Oct 29, post 2243683471980145632 ($4.51/link click by then).
- Shifted spend to the two leaders for the final days and raised daily budgets to use the remaining flight budget.

- **Spend: $490.31 USD** of the $500.00 cap
